title: You booked it like a standup
thesis: Book the passion like a job and your brain clocks in.
description: Cairn books the keyboard like a standup. His brain clocks in. One thesis. Book the passion like a job and it starts to feel like work.

hook.vo: Wrote KEYS on it like it was standup. Yellow square. Start time. End time.
hook.caption: Yellow square.

hook.vo: Opens the calendar. Deletes Tuesday at seven. Square's gone. Week looks empty.
hook.caption: Square's gone.

scenes.caption: This is Cairn.
scenes.vo: This is Cairn.

scenes.caption: Little stack of rocks.
scenes.vo: Little stack of rocks. Stick arms.

scenes.caption: A room with a desk and a keyboard.
scenes.vo: Lives in a room with a desk and a keyboard.

scenes.caption: Not your teacher.
scenes.vo: Not your teacher. Just a guy who keeps going back to the thing he likes.

scenes.caption: The keyboard was just a keyboard.
scenes.vo: Tuesday the keyboard was just a keyboard.

scenes.caption: It was on the desk.
scenes.vo: It was on the desk.

scenes.caption: He walked in because he felt like it.
scenes.vo: Cairn walked in because he felt like it.

scenes.caption: Nobody texted him.
scenes.vo: Nobody texted him.

scenes.caption: He played until it got dark.
scenes.vo: He played until it got dark.

scenes.caption: Didn't check the time.
scenes.vo: Didn't check the time.

scenes.caption: Didn't owe the chair a full hour.
scenes.vo: Didn't owe the chair a full hour.

scenes.caption: Left when the song was done.
scenes.vo: Left when the song was done. Or when he got bored. That's allowed.

scenes.caption: That's the fun part.
scenes.vo: That's the fun part. You just show up. You don't plan it.

scenes.caption: Then he got serious.
scenes.vo: Then he got serious.

scenes.caption: Opened his calendar.
scenes.vo: Opened his calendar. Made a block. Tuesday. Seven.

scenes.caption: Wrote KEYS.
scenes.vo: Wrote KEYS on it like it was standup.

scenes.caption: Yellow square.
scenes.vo: Yellow square. Start time. End time.

scenes.caption: He put the room in the invite.
scenes.vo: Even put the room in the invite like someone else was coming.

scenes.caption: He was proud of that.
scenes.vo: He was proud of that. Felt grown. Like, okay, I'm not flaking on this anymore.

scenes.caption: He checked the square twice.
scenes.vo: Wednesday he checked the square twice. Still there. Nice. He had a practice now.

scenes.caption: Told a friend.
scenes.vo: Told a friend. I blocked time for it. Friend said fire. Cairn felt like an adult.

scenes.caption: Walked past. Didn't touch it.
scenes.vo: Wednesday night he walked past the keyboard and didn't touch it.

scenes.caption: He had a block tomorrow.
scenes.vo: He had a block tomorrow. Saving it. That felt responsible too.

scenes.caption: Thursday the square actually hit.
scenes.vo: Thursday the square actually hit.

scenes.caption: Clock hits seven.
scenes.vo: Clock hits seven.

scenes.caption: Chair's already out.
scenes.vo: Chair's already out.

scenes.caption: Cairn sits down like it's a meeting.
scenes.vo: Cairn sits down like it's a meeting.

scenes.caption: Hands on the keys.
scenes.vo: Hands on the keys. Waiting to want it.

scenes.caption: He does not want it.
scenes.vo: He does not want it.

scenes.caption: Same keyboard. Same room.
scenes.vo: Same keyboard. Same room. Totally different vibe.

scenes.caption: Brain is in the standup.
scenes.vo: Hands know what to do. Brain is in the standup.

scenes.caption: He's watching the clock.
scenes.vo: He's watching the clock.

scenes.caption: He plays the whole hour anyway.
scenes.vo: He plays the whole hour anyway because the calendar said so.

scenes.caption: Block ends.
scenes.vo: Block ends. He stands up like the call is over.

scenes.caption: Closes the lid. Leaves on time.
scenes.vo: Closes the lid. Leaves on time.

scenes.caption: Felt like he attended.
scenes.vo: He did the hour. Could've checked a box. Didn't feel like he played. Felt like he attended.

scenes.caption: Walks past the desk and feels guilty.
scenes.vo: Friday morning he walks past the desk and feels guilty.

scenes.caption: Keyboard's looking at him.
scenes.vo: Not fail-a-test guilty. Keyboard's just sitting there looking at him. Like a task he didn't finish.

scenes.caption: He makes coffee. Walks past it again.
scenes.vo: He makes coffee. Walks past it again. Still feels it.

scenes.caption: Saturday he just looks.
scenes.vo: Saturday he does it again. Not at seven. Just looks. Keyboard didn't move. The feeling did.

scenes.caption: Now he walks over and it's homework.
scenes.vo: Used to walk over and want it. Now he walks over and it's homework.

scenes.caption: Puts his mug down and leaves.
scenes.vo: Puts his mug down and leaves so he doesn't owe it another minute.

scenes.caption: Someone on a writing board said it.
scenes.vo: Someone on a writing board said it. What's a passion will turn into a chore. An artist said they booked an hour to be creative and then sat there in nothing. Another person said they feel guilty every time they see the keyboard.

scenes.caption: That's the walk.
scenes.vo: Cairn was like yeah. That's the walk.

scenes.caption: His brain did work-brain.
scenes.vo: He didn't fall off the thing. He put it on the calendar like work. So his brain did work-brain. Clocked in.

scenes.caption: One move. One result.
scenes.vo: That's the whole story. One move. One result.

scenes.caption: Calendar mindset.
scenes.vo: People who study this gave it a boring name. Calendar mindset. They had people put a clock time on stuff that used to be free. Dinner. A walk. A hobby hour. Once it had a start time, it felt like a job. The fun didn't leave the thing. The fun left when the block showed up.

scenes.caption: He has the yellow square.
scenes.vo: Cairn doesn't need their chart. He has the yellow square. That's the chart.

scenes.caption: So he does the small thing.
scenes.vo: So he does the small thing.

scenes.caption: Deletes Tuesday at seven.
scenes.vo: Opens the calendar. Deletes Tuesday at seven.

scenes.caption: Square's gone.
scenes.vo: Square's gone. Week looks empty. That's the point. He doesn't make a better standup. Doesn't write KEYS 2. Doesn't set a reminder to be inspired.

scenes.caption: If he wants the keyboard, he walks over.
scenes.vo: If he wants the keyboard, he walks over.

scenes.caption: If he doesn't, he walks past.
scenes.vo: If he doesn't, he walks past. He doesn't owe it an hour.

scenes.caption: Doesn't sit. Leaves. No guilt.
scenes.vo: That night he tests it. Goes to the desk. Doesn't sit. Leaves. No guilt. Keyboard's just furniture again.

scenes.caption: Later he walks over at four.
scenes.vo: Later he walks over at four. No reason.

scenes.caption: Plays one song because he's already there.
scenes.vo: Plays one song because he's already there. Stops when it's done.

scenes.caption: One stone.
scenes.vo: Puts that on the pile. One stone. A session that happened. Not a streak. Not a 7pm personality.

scenes.caption: Keyboard's just a keyboard again.
scenes.vo: Keyboard's just a keyboard again.

scenes.caption: He booked it like a standup.
scenes.vo: The passion didn't die. He booked it like a standup.

scenes.caption: If this week's takeaway stuck, subscribe.
scenes.vo: If this week's takeaway stuck, subscribe. Next one lands same time.
